meta.parties: Karunaratne v. Gabriel, Appuhamy Et Al

rules.statement: In Ceylon, the principles of Roman-Dutch law regarding the right of the owner of a servient tenement to change the situation of a prescriptive right of way are not applicable.
rules.supporting_quote: "How far the principles of the Roman-Dutch law to which-I have referred are applicable to a case where the right to pass over a defined track has been acquired by prescription is a question of some difficulty; but so far as the present appeal is concerned, the questions are purely academic."
